{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop QA rows (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders with converted = 1
refunded_converted = df[(df['status'] == 'refunded') & (df['converted'] == 1)]
print("Refunded orders with converted = 1:", len(refunded_converted))

# Define true conversion: completed checkout AND not refunded
# So only orders with converted == 1 AND status == 'completed'
df['true_converted'] = (df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'completed')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute fraction of true conversions among loyal customers
fraction_converted = loyal_df['true_converted'].mean()

# Print final results explicitly
print("\n=== FINAL RESULTS ===")
print("Total loyal customers:", len(loyal_df))
print("True conversions among loyal:", loyal_df['true_converted'].sum())
print("Fraction true converted:", fraction_converted)

# Return value for submission
fraction_converted"}
